schema: brain-age model fairness passport, criteria v2
fixed_on: 2026-10-25, before any Phase 10 cross-validation result was available
margin_rationale: Smallest group difference in brain-age gap considered meaningful: about half the model's MAE (3.7 years) and below the 3-5 year gaps usually interpreted in brain-age studies.

verdict_levels.PASS: equivalence shown: the 90% CI lies inside +/- margin (two one-sided tests, alpha 0.05)
verdict_levels.INCONCLUSIVE: the 95% CI includes 0 but equivalence is not shown (the data cannot decide)
verdict_levels.CONCERN: the 95% CI excludes 0 but the effect is within the margin, or it does not replicate in an independent split
verdict_levels.FAIL: the 95% CI excludes 0, |effect| >= margin, and the effect replicates in an independent split

accuracy.pass_if: MAE upper 95% CI <= 5 years and Pearson r lower 95% CI >= 0.90

fairness_sex.rule: verdict_levels on the age-adjusted male-vs-female difference, for both brain-age gap and absolute error; the worse of the two is reported

fairness_site.rule: verdict_levels on each age-adjusted site-vs-reference difference, gap and absolute error; the worst site is reported

scanner_invariance.rule: verdict_levels on the mean change in predicted age when only the intensity appearance is swapped to another site (relative to own-site matching), worst site pair; replication = a separately trained model

site_encoding.rule: informational: probe balanced accuracy compared with the 95th percentile of a label-permutation null

faithful_explanations.pass_if: randomisation-check median Spearman < 0.5 AND top-ranked deletion beats random deletion (Wilcoxon p < 0.05) under every deletion baseline

honest_uncertainty.pass_if: coverage of the model's own central 90% range is within [0.85, 0.95] for every site

primary_analysis: Phase 10 cross-validated out-of-sample predictions (all 412 train+val subjects); replication = the locked test set (fold ensemble). The original single-split results are reported alongside.
